identity.title: The ALMA Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS). First results from an unbiased submillimeter wavelength line survey of the Class 0 protostellar binary IRAS 16293-2422 with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: An unbiased spectral survey of IRAS 16293$-$2422 covering the full frequency range from 329 to 363 GHz (0.8 mm) has been obtained with ALMA

evidence.quote: We therefore adopt a distance of 120 pc throughout this paper.
We therefore adopt a distance of 120 pc throughout this paper.

distance_source.value: adopted from extinction and VLBI parallax measurements of the rho Oph cloud (Rivera et al. 2015 cited)

evidence.quote: We therefore adopt a distance of 120 pc throughout this paper.

question.value: What is the chemical complexity of the Class 0 protostellar binary IRAS 16293-2422 on solar-system scales, and how are glycolaldehyde, its isomers and isotopologues formed?

evidence.quote: The goal is to introduce a systematic survey, “Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS)”, of the chemical complexity of one of the nearby astrochemical templates
in ALMA’s Cycle 2 (project-id: 2013.1.00278.S)
obtained in Cycle 1 (project-id: 2012.1.00712.S)

bands.value: Band 7 (329-363 GHz) unbiased survey; Band 6 (~230 GHz) and Band 3 (~100 GHz) selected windows

evidence.quote: selected windows in ALMA’s Bands 3 ($\approx$3 mm, or 100 GHz) and 6 ($\approx$1.3 mm, or 230 GHz) obtained in Cycle 1

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Band 7: 18 settings of 1875 MHz (four 468.75 MHz windows), 0.244 MHz (~0.2 km/s) resolution, 1920 channels per window

evidence.quote: In total 18 spectral settings were observed: each setting covers a bandwidth of 1875 MHz (over four different spectral windows, 468.75 MHz wide).

lines_targeted.species: glycolaldehyde, ethylene glycol (aGg', gGg'), acetic acid, CH3 18OH, isotopologues

evidence.loc: Line identification, temperatures and column densities
evidence.quote: Table [\[band3measurements\]](#band3measurements) lists the parameters from Gaussian fits to the lines of glycolaldehyde as well as the two conformers of ethylene glycol in the central beam toward IRAS16293B

arrays.value: Band 7: 12 m array plus ACA (7 m); Bands 3 and 6: 12 m only

evidence.quote: Data were obtained from both the array of 12 m dishes (typically 36–41 antennas in the array at the time of observations) and the “Atacama Compact Array (ACA)”
For these settings only the 12-m array was utilised

analysis_steps.goal: test LTE with non-LTE methanol excitation

method.value: Radex calculations of Tex vs Tkin for CH3OH, rms deviation over 82 transitions

evidence.quote: we use the escape probability code *Radex* (cite: vandertak07radex) to solve the radiative transfer problem for the largest complex molecule methanol
models with $T_{\rm kin}$ of 50, 100 and 300 K, respectively, with densities varying from $10^6-10^{12}$ cm$^{-3}$
the deviations are less than 15% for these three kinetic temperatures

analysis_steps.goal: derive column densities by LTE synthetic spectra and rotation diagrams

method.value: compare LTE synthetic spectra to spectra at half beam offset from IRAS16293B; rotation diagrams for Band 3 lines

evidence.quote: the approach taken for this analysis, as well as for other species in Bands 6 and 7, is to calculate synthetic spectra of the targeted molecules and directly compare those to the extracted spectra

key_parameters.value: Tex = 300 K; source size 0.5''; fixed line width and LSR velocity

evidence.quote: We adopt a source size of 0.5$''$

assumptions.value: LTE, 16O/18O = 560, vibrational corrections (1.47 glycolaldehyde vs JPL; 4.02 ethylene glycol; 1.38 gGg')

evidence.quote: the main species needs to be increased by a factor 1.47 compared to estimates derived using the partition function given in the JPL catalog

fitting.value: by-eye comparison of synthetic and observed spectra; linear fits for rotation diagrams

evidence.loc: Line identification, temperatures and column densities
evidence.quote: The total column density of the molecule and its kinetic temperature can thus be derived from linear fits to plots of $\ln \left(N_u / g_u\right)$ as function of $E_{\rm up}$

validation.value: no lines predicted where none observed

evidence.quote: A strong test of the assignments is that no lines are predicted to show emission at frequencies where none is seen in the spectra.

method.value: synthetic spectra of 13C and D isotopologues with vibrational corrections 3.29 (OD) and 2.80

evidence.quote: the column density of the OD isotopologue needs to be increased by 3.29 and those of all other isotopologues by 2.80
The calibration and imaging proceeded according to the standard recipes in CASA.
we use the escape probability code *Radex* (cite: vandertak07radex)

approximately 10,000 lines are seen toward the position half a beam away from the continuum peak

Glycolaldehyde | $284\pm 27$ K

results_numeric.quantity: lower limit H2 column toward B

findings_qualitative.value: Glycolaldehyde and ethylene glycol are overabundant relative to methanol vs SgrB2(N); gGg' conformer first detected in the ISM

evidence.quote: with the detection of one of these, the $gGg'$ conformer, the first reported detection in the ISM

claims.hypothesis: Is LTE valid at the scales probed?

evidence.quote: LTE is a good approximation for CH$_3$OH and presumably for most other molecules.

claims.hypothesis: Is glycolaldehyde deuteration uniform across functional groups?
claims.finding: no difference between groups, in contrast to methanol

evidence.quote: The D/H ratio for glycolaldehyde is $\approx$ 5% for all three deuterated isotopologues
lower than the ratio of 68$\pm$15 of the local interstellar medium

why_this_method.value: line confusion makes line-free channels and rotation diagrams impractical, so synthetic spectra used

evidence.quote: For this reason it is not practical to identify individual lines and create rotation diagrams based on those.

limitations_admitted.value: Abundances relative to H2 highly uncertain as continuum is optically thick

evidence.quote: even as a limit the abundance with respect to H$_2$ is highly uncertain

referee_caveats_inferred: Fits by eye without formal uncertainties
Optically thick continuum and offset position affect column densities
